editorial.blurb: Progressive Indian cuisine that balances bold flavors with refined subtlety, from tender Brisket Masala to fragrant biryani, in a warm Northshore destination.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early or expect a wait—the restaurant draws crowds, especially during local events—but the genuine owners and attentive service make the wait worthwhile.

topDishes.note: Fabulous and exceeded expectations; seasoned potatoes are standout
Classic preparation with tons of quality chicken
Delicious and satisfying enough to inhale
